selection: Among converged candidates with a feasible development precision/recall threshold, select minimum cross-fitted weighted log loss, then Brier. If none are feasible, select minimum log loss for research only and do not score final.
limits: Repeated development model selection is optimistic. This is a separate expanded study, not a rerun of the historical final test or a production approval.
reference: Old 299-row SEC-target base estimator, unwrapped from its old calibrator and recalibrated in the same development folds. Prior development selection exposure is explicit. Its historical negatives inherit the old BRD scope.
filing_signals: Seven point-in-time metadata features; sparse event counts and missingness indicators are not quantile-clipped. Financial preprocessing remains training-only. Fixed candidate list, no final model inputs or scores read.
